name: clawmetry-setup-openclaw
description: Pinned OpenClaw CLI for the setup-openclaw composite action. CI-only: nothing here ships in the clawmetry wheel or is imported by the dashboard.
//overrides: The openclaw pin cannot move: see the note on this directory's Dependabot
entry in .github/dependabot.yml. `npm audit fix` -- which resolves every
finding here by bumping openclaw -- is not available to us.
TWO separate things block the bump, and only the second one used to be
written down. Measured 2026-09-22 against the published tarballs and a
re-resolved lockfile; both halves are reproducible from the steps named.
1. THE OVERRIDES BELOW STOP APPLYING. This is the nearer blocker and it
bites well before the transcript format does. 2026.5.12 hoists its
dependency tree to the root (node_modules/tar, node_modules/undici,
...), which is where the range-scoped keys below match. Re-resolving
at 2026.5.27 nests the same packages under node_modules/openclaw/,
where the keys no longer match, and pulls in vulnerable transitives
the 5.12 tree does not have (hono, fast-uri, protobufjs, ip-address,
linkify-it, brace-expansion, qs, body-parser). Net effect of that bare
bump, by `npm audit` on a lockfile regenerated from this package.json
with only the version changed: 4 vulnerable packages / 26 advisories
BEFORE, 16 packages / 67 advisories AFTER, including a critical (tar
GHSA-23hp-3jrh-7fpw) that the tar@7 override currently clears. A bump
is a net REGRESSION until this whole block is re-derived against the
nested tree. Do not treat it as a version change.
2. The SQLite transcript boundary, which is real but is NOT at 2026.5.12.
That figure was the last version known-green, not a measured edge.
2026.5.27 still resolves transcripts through the same
resolveSessionTranscriptsDirForAgent -> path.join(agentRoot,
"sessions") path and ships no agent SQLite module, so it writes the
per-session agents/main/sessions/*.jsonl that clawmetry/sync.py globs.
2026.6.34 ships dist/openclaw-agent-db.paths-*.js and a sqlite-*.js
bundle. So the transition is somewhere in 2026.5.28..2026.6.34. Grep a
candidate tarball for `openclaw-agent.sqlite|transcript_events` to
place it; absent means it is still on the JSONL side.
Note for whoever moves the pin: engines went >=22.16.0 (5.12) to
>=22.19.0 (5.27). The action's `node-version` default is the bare
major "22", which setup-node resolves to the newest 22.x, so that
default already satisfies the narrower range.
These overrides take the subset of that fix that does NOT require moving
openclaw: each is a patch/minor bump inside the major the tree already
resolves, so no consumer sees a new API surface. Keys are range-scoped
(name@major) deliberately -- a bare `undici` key would also rewrite the
undici@7.29.1 that @earendil-works/pi-ai resolves, which IS a major bump.
tar@7    7.5.15 / 7.5.13 -> 7.5.22  clears GHSA-23hp-3jrh-7fpw (critical),
GHSA-8x88-c5mf-7j5w, GHSA-r292-9mhp-454m,
GHSA-vmf3-w455-68vh, GHSA-w8wr-v893-vjvp,
GHSA-gvwx-54wh-qm9j
undici@8 8.2.0 -> 8.10.2            clears GHSA-vmh5-mc38-953g and the ten
other 8.x advisories
ws@8     8.20.0 -> 8.21.3           clears GHSA-96hv-2xvq-fx4p, GHSA-58qx-3vcg-4xpx
markdown-it@14                      clears GHSA-6v5v-wf23-fmfq
markdown-it was previously listed below as uncoverable, on the grounds that
its only fix was 15.x. That is no longer true: upstream backported the
smartquotes fix into the 14 line (14.3.1, then 14.3.2, both published after
15.0.2). The advisory range is <=14.1.1, so 14.3.2 is out of range while
staying inside the major the tree already resolves -- the same shape as the
three overrides above, and no new API surface for any consumer.
What these deliberately do NOT cover, because no override can:
extract-zip      GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv and GHSA-7pqw-9j4j-h8q3 have no fixed
release; 2.0.1 is latest and is itself in range.
pdfjs-dist       fix is 6.2.108, a major bump from the 5.7.284 in tree.
pi-coding-agent  fix is 0.79.0, which arrives with the openclaw bump.
openclaw itself  19 advisories, fixed across 2026.5.18..2026.6.5. Every
one is fixed only by the version bump.
Those stay open against the pin. Re-confirmed 2026-09-22: extract-zip is
still 2.0.1 (published 2020, latest, in range), and pi-coding-agent 0.74.2
-- the only release between the pinned 0.74.0 and the openclaw bump -- is
inside every one of its four advisory ranges, so it buys nothing.
These 26 advisories are the WHOLE of what OSSF Scorecard reports as this
repository's VulnerabilitiesID: 19 openclaw, 4 pi-coding-agent, 2
extract-zip, 1 pdfjs-dist. Nothing else in the repo contributes one, so a
reader chasing that score is looking at this pin and nowhere else.
They close when BOTH blockers above clear: the overrides re-derived against
the nested tree, and the daemon able to read the OpenClaw SQLite transcript
if the pin moves past 2026.5.28..2026.6.34.
